projects.title: SkillLens
projects.subtitle: AI Resume Screening
projects.description: An AI-powered resume-screening pipeline that uses hybrid retrieval to surface relevant candidates beyond keyword matching.

Automatic inference of requested result counts from user phrasing
metrics: Uses top-three chunk similarity scores to reduce long-document score dilution
